trigger: Night. Kit at the back door (if trust.kit >= 3).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A tap at the back door. Three, then two. Kit, white with cold, goggles iced over.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Don't talk. Listen. The Viaduct guys are hitting Gil's garage tonight. For the diesel.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: They've got bottles. Gas bottles. Somebody's going to burn that garage, Wrench.

choices.text: Thank you. Go. Get out of here.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Because I scouted it. Okay? I walked by twice. They paid me in soup. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: I didn't know they had bottles. I swear I didn't know about the bottles.

choices.text: You sold out my neighbor for soup.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Yeah. I did. You want to fight about soup or you want to wake up your neighbor?
